We have everything you are looking for to complete your project. Browse our wide variety of products to discover what we offer in appliances, bath and faucets, building materials, window treatments, and more.We are happy to help you begin your project. We have DIY guides that provide inspiration and product details. We also have step-by-step project guides if you could use some help.Unsure if you'll still need those project-specific tools once your work is finished? Check out our tool rental offering to rent what you need and easily return it after you are finished. We also offer truck rentals to help you transport larger items.When you don't want to tackle the work on your own, let us do it for you. The Home Depot offers Home Services in your city and can take you from idea to done.You can also download our mobile app, too, so you can shop no matter where you are. Check back frequently to learn more about our newest sales and promotions!Frequently Asked QuestionsWhat items qualify for same-day or next-day delivery?We've expanded our delivery speed capabilities to include a vast range of products! More than 25,000 items are eligible for same-day delivery, ideal for those urgent project needs. We also have a vast variety of qualifying items for next-day delivery, giving you a huge offering from tools to building materials. Look for the "Same-Day Delivery" or "Next-Day Delivery" badges and estimated delivery times on product pages and during checkout.Do you offer military discounts?Is there a Home Depot app?Our mobile app was made for doers. The store mode shows what's in stock and where it's located in your local store. The barcode scanner pulls up product specifications, reviews, and ratings so you can learn more before you make a purchase. Image search helps you uncover what something is, making it easier to replace it. Our app also includes additional features like augmented reality capabilities, shopping lists, and the ability to check a gift card balance or make payments on your Home Depot Credit Card. Download our app to get more done on the go.How much concrete will I need?How can I see the balance of my Home Depot gift card?Gift cards to The Home Depot are an excellent present for any special occasion or holiday. DIYers know they are fabulous to both receive and give. If you have a gift card, you can visit your local Home Depot store and ask a cashier to check your balance or you can simply check your gift card balance online. Our gift cards can be redeemed in-store or used to make purchases online without additional fees.How do I arrange a bulk delivery?For many bulk items, you can add the desired amount to your shopping cart online and proceed to checkout, where delivery options and costs will be calculated based on your location and the size/weight of your order. We recommend contacting your local store or our Pro Desk for extremely large or specialized bulk orders. Delivery charges vary based on the order size, distance, and specific delivery services that you choose.What's on sale at The Home Depot?Check out our Savings Center to get the scoop on sales. From holiday savings to one-day-only specials, we have a variety of ways to save on your next project.How long do I have to return items?The Home Depot makes returns easy. You can return purchases by mail or in-store. Many items can be returned within 90 days with proof of purchase. Find additional info by checking out our return policy.Where can I view my order status?Is it delivery day yet? We get it. Waiting is tough, especially when you've got an exciting new project to start working on. That's why we've made it easy to check your order status.
